name: Quarter Frame Solver
description: Experimental practice-mode checkpoint, input timing search, and fast tick stepping.

enabled.name: Enable experimental solver
enabled.description: Works only in Practice Mode. Enable, then restart the level.

hertz.name: Simulation ticks per second (F)
hertz.description: The checkpoint spacing is round(F / 4) simulation ticks. Match the game's effective physics tick rate.

steps-per-render.name: Simulation steps per rendered frame
steps-per-render.description: Experimental acceleration. 1 is normal; 4 or 8 skips some renders. Raises CPU workload and can conflict with other timing mods.
